desc: Derive and verify formula: ans = C(n-1, k) * m * (m-1)^(n-k-1) mod MOD (bijection: choose k equal-gap positions among n-1 gaps -> n-k runs; first run has m choices, each subsequent run m-1 choices). Matches all three samples.
Implement the full solution in countGoodArrays: precompute fact/inv_fact up to n-1 using Fermat inverse, compute C(n-1, k), multiply by m and pow(m-1, n-k-1, MOD), return mod MOD.

Test against the three samples plus edge cases: verified n=3/m=2/k=1 → 4, n=4/m=2/k=2 → 6, n=5/m=2/k=0 → 2; edge cases n=1/k=0 → m, m=1/k=n-1 → 1, m=1/k<n-1 → 0 all handled correctly by the formula (pow(0, 0, MOD) == 1 in Python).
